title: Import Lightroom AI masks from ACR sidecars
source: rapidroom (original implementation with Codex; shared ACR reader credited separately)
notes: Read-only, bounded import of 8-bit grayscale TIFF/JPEG XL mask rasters with checked content references, sensor/default-crop placement, EXIF orientation and fine rotation. Supplied subject, sky, object and people coverage becomes persisted bitmap masks, including mixed gradient/brush corrections. Unsupported payloads or incomplete corrections are reported by name; ordinary renders are unchanged. Lightroom slider calibration remains unverified.
